regions.cleaned_text: Nov. 29 1st of Advent (N. Yr. ) Penance the primary end of the Minor Friar - therefore a vocation to same implies first of all - penance - and whatever is of pain or death must be received at least with resignation - better with gratitude. - what does well that for which it was in- tended will be valued - otherwise neglected. If the Creator desires or requires penance, what better can the creature do? Deo Gratias! Retreat Dec. 1903 Think of death every night after going to bed.

regions.cleaned_text: Retr. Before Ordination "The lion-king of the forest excepting himself. The chaste man, king of this world & master of himself." St. Romoald's Vocation, by a 40 days penance for a murder by his Father in a duel. Feb. 1 St. Brigid bn. in (Ulster) Fochard 453 AD. Her prayer for deformity is heard until she receives her snow-white veil when her former beauty returns.
